jobs.title: Consultant, Service Development
jobs.jd_full:
Start your journey with BCD: Grow, connect, collaborate and celebrate with our global team

 

Consultant, Service Development (Remote)

Full time, Spain, Netherlands, Czech Republic, Denmark, France, Germany, Poland, United Kingdom

If you are located in the Warsaw area, you will need to work in-office for 50% of working time monthly. If you are located in the Kraków and Rzeszów areas, you will need to work in-office at least 1 day per week.

 

The Consultant, Service Development will contribute to the successful delivery of projects and initiatives within the Service and Commercial Development team. This position will collaborate with stakeholders across the organization to ensure understanding of each initiative and its impact to our organization to assure that the solution we create addresses the business requirements. 

 

The role will serve as support for project task completion, working closely with Operations and local leaders to implement business best practices for the assigned areas.

 

The Consultant, Service Development coordinates resources and works as subject matter expert for successful implementation of new processes, technology and multinational practices based on local specifics.

 

As a Consultant, Service Development, you will

  • Support initiatives and ensure all project standards are adhered to and the agreed business benefits are realized
  • Serve as a process, project and/or product subject matter expert
  • Serve as liaison point between the account, the region and the project team
  • Facilitate effective communication as required for successful project completion
  • Coordinate resources for successful implementations of new processes, standardizations and technology
  • Analyze business issues, defines possible solutions aiming for the best productivity increase

 

About you

  • Prior corporate travel industry experience including customer-facing agency operations
  • Proficient in doing customer discovery and documentation
  • Thorough knowledge of all aspects of the internal BCD Travel operational processes and services
  • Extensive knowledge of BCD Travel client and internal technologies (GDS, scripts, TA, OBT’s, fulfillment technology etc.)
  • Good communication and influencing skills with a proven history of successfully collaborating with internal and external stakeholders
  • Strong organizational and project management skills
  • Excellent oral and written English language skills

 

What we offer you

At BCD Travel, we work with highly motivated and passionate people. We value open communication, collaboration, and a flexible work-life balance. We offer unique, often global, experiences that empower you to develop and grow within the organization. Sustainability and helping others is also high on our list. We make a difference through charitable activities in our communities across the globe.

 

About us

BCD Travel helps companies travel smart and achieve more. We drive program adoption, cost savings and talent retention through digital experiences that simplify business travel. Our 15,000+ dedicated team members service clients in 170+ countries as we shape a sustainable future for business travel. BCD’s leading meetings and events management and global consultancy services complete our comprehensive suite of solutions for all aspects of corporate travel. In 2024, BCD achieved US$22.9 billion in sales. For more information, visit www.bcdtravel.com.

 

Get to know us by reading our blog and checking out our social media:

  • https://www.bcdtravel.com/blog/
  • https://www.linkedin.com/company/bcd-travel/
  • https://www.instagram.com/bcdtravel/
  • https://www.facebook.com/bcdtravel/

 

You’ll be offered

  • Flexible working hours and work-from-home or remote opportunities
  • Opportunities to grow your skillset and career
  • Generous vacation days so you can rest and recharge
  • A compensation package that feels fair to you, including mental, physical, and financial wellbeing tools
  • Travel industry professional perks and discounts
  • An inclusive work environment where diversity is celebrated

 

At BCD Travel, we value you—our culture and success are defined by our people. We carefully consider a wide range of objective, gender‑neutral compensation factors, including professional background, skills, experience, and role scope.

 

This position is advertised across multiple European locations. The expected annual gross salary ranges by country are as follows:

  • Spain: 28,000 - 38,500 Euros Annually
  • France: 33,000 - 36,000 Euros Annually
  • Poland: 78,000 - 125,000 Polish Zloty Annually
  • Germany: 53,000 - 62,000 Euros Annually
  • Netherlands: 42,000 - 60,000 Euros Annually
  • Czech Republic: 750,000 - 820,000 Koruna Annually

 

The final salary offered will ultimately depend on the candidate’s qualifications, experience, and location, and will be determined in line with internal equity.

 

We do not request salary history and are committed to equal pay in line with the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

 

Ready to join the journey? Apply now!

We’re dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If you’re excited about a role, but your experience doesn’t align perfectly, we still encourage you to apply.


We are committed to providing reasonable and necessary accommodations to ensure all employees can perform their roles effectively. For accommodation requests or further information, contact our Talent Acquisition department at careers@bcdtravel.com.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
The company and our mission: 

Zartis is a global AI transformation and technology consulting partner where talented engineers and technologists work on cutting edge innovation. We partner with ambitious organizations to design, build, and scale technology solutions that deliver real impact.

Our teams bring deep expertise in AI driven platforms, secure API architectures, and cloud native engineering. You will work on meaningful projects that accelerate the adoption of advanced technologies, from strategy and discovery through to full product delivery, helping turn complex challenges into measurable outcomes.

With engineering hubs across EMEA and LATAM, and long term partnerships in financial services, healthcare and life sciences, and energy and climate, we offer opportunities to work on projects that truly matter. Here, you will not just build technology, you will drive business impact and grow your career alongside industry leaders.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to work on a project in the fitness industry.

The project:

Our teammates are talented people that come from a variety of backgrounds. We’re committed to building an inclusive culture based on trust and innovation.

You will be part of a distributed team working on a SaaS platform for the fitness industry, supporting gym owners, studio operators and franchise networks with bookings, memberships and day-to-day operations. 

We are looking for someone with strong communication skills, demonstrable customer obsession, experience translating a high-level vision into a grounded, sequenced roadmap, and comfort making prioritisation calls in ambiguous environments. 

What you will do:

  • Own the strategy, roadmap and measurable outcomes for your product area, balancing near-term delivery with long-term product vision.

  • Talk to customers daily, gym owners, studio operators, and front-desk staff to deeply understand their problems and translate them into prioritised, well-scoped product work.

  • Partner with engineering, design, data and QA to ship high-quality, well-instrumented product experiences in short, iterative cycles.

  • Use quantitative and qualitative evidence to define success metrics, evaluate shipped work, and continuously improve your product area.

  • Drive business cases for new capabilities, including pricing considerations, go-to-market fit and commercial impact, in collaboration with sales, marketing and customer success.

  • Understand the competitive landscape and evolving market needs to identify where the product can lead, follow or differentiate.

  • Scope solutions to their smallest coherent state, ship early, gather real-world feedback, and iterate with urgency.

  • Align stakeholders across the business on roadmap priorities, delivery milestones and product decisions, using clear, data-backed communication.

  • Support product marketing in developing positioning and messaging that resonates with gym operators.

  • Maintain a healthy, well-groomed backlog and work closely with engineering leads to manage trade-offs between velocity, quality and scope.

 

What you will bring:

  • 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS with a track record of owning and shipping complex product areas end-to-end.

  • Demonstrable customer obsession, you default to talking to users, not about them, and use research to sharpen your instincts rather than replace them.

  • Strong analytical mindset: comfortable defining metrics, querying data, and making prioritisation calls in ambiguous environments.

  • Experience translating a high-level vision into a grounded, sequenced roadmap with clear success criteria.

  • The ability to work fluidly across discovery and delivery, switching between strategic thinking and hands-on backlog management as the situation demands.

  • Strong stakeholder communication skills, able to write crisp product briefs, run effective reviews, and influence without authority across engineering, design, and the business.

  • Comfort working in fast-paced, iterative environments with cross-functional teams distributed across time zones.

  • A degree from an accredited university or college, or equivalent relevant experience.

 

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with the fitness, wellness or hospitality industry, or prior experience selling into or building for SMB and enterprise operators.

  • Exposure to platform or multi-tenant SaaS products where configuration, access control and white-labelling are first-class concerns.

  • Experience with product analytics tools (e.g. Mixpanel, Amplitude, Pendo) and a strong habit of defining and tracking outcome metrics.

  • A working understanding of agile ceremonies and how to keep a team focused and unblocked across a complex backlog.

  • Strong leadership presence, the ability to rally a team around a vision and maintain momentum through ambiguity.

What we offer: 

  • 100% Remote Work

  • WFH allowance: Monthly payment as financial support for remote working.

  • Career Growth: We have established a career development program accessible for all employees with a 360º feedback that will help us to guide you in your career progression.

  • Training: For Tech training at Zartis, you have time allocated during the week at your disposal. You can request from a variety of options, such as online courses (from Pluralsight and Educative.io, for example), English classes, books, conferences, and events.

  • Mentoring Program: You can become a mentor in Zartis or you can receive mentorship, or both.

  • Zartis Wellbeing Hub (Kara Connect): A platform that provides sessions with a range of specialists, including mental health professionals, nutritionists, physiotherapists, fitness coaches, and webinars with such professionals as well.

  • Multicultural working environment: We organize tech events, webinars, parties, and activities to do online team-building games and contests.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Agent Ecosystem
jobs.jd_full:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust.We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it.

Customers increasingly use AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and internal Slack agents to run their business processes, and security and compliance work is no exception. For those agents to do that work, they need access to Vanta’s trust graph and intelligence layer. Vanta is building for that world: security and compliance products that customers can use through Vanta, through third-party agent platforms, and inside their own internal tools.

As Senior Product Manager, Agent Ecosystem, you will own Vanta’s external agent surfaces: MCP, CLI, and plugins in marketplaces like Claude Code, Codex, and ChatGPT. Your job is to make Vanta the trusted compliance layer that agents rely on. You will define the strategy, ship the products, and own the outcomes.

What you’ll do as a Senior Product Manager, Agent Ecosystem at Vanta:

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for Vanta’s agent ecosystem products.

  • Define how agents discover, access, and safely use Vanta capabilities, partnering with the platform teams that own APIs and authentication.

  • Hold outcome parity as a product principle: work a customer can complete in Vanta should be possible through MCP, CLI, and plugin surfaces too.

  • Lead marketplace and plugin launches, aligning product, engineering, legal, security, and go-to-market around each one.

  • Partner with engineering and design to ship secure, reliable developer products.

  • Build the developer-facing marketing motion: external agent documentation and customer stories that show what MCP and CLI users have unlocked.

  • Partner with the product partnerships and alliances team on co-marketing with agent platforms like Anthropic and OpenAI, keeping a pulse on the agent ecosystem so Vanta is part of the key stacks.

  • Define adoption and quality metrics, and use customer and product data to prioritize.

How to be successful in this role:

  • 5+ years of product management experience, taking products from strategy through to shipped outcomes.

  • Experience shipping developer-facing or programmatic products (APIs, integrations, plugins, SDKs, or CLI tools), and comfort treating MCP, CLI, and plugins as product surfaces.

  • Technical fluency with APIs, authentication, and developer tools. Hands-on experience building with AI and agent tools, not just evaluating them.

  • Experience taking complex products or partnerships from strategy through launch.

  • Ability to connect ecosystem opportunities to customer problems and product outcomes.

  • Experience building relationships with technology platforms, AI companies, developer communities, or enterprise customers.

  • Experience leading cross-functional work across product, engineering, design, marketing, partnerships, legal, and go-to-market.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, and sound judgment in ambiguous environments.

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work, demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors and may vary based on candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials.

#LI-remote

At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.

About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world’s leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged.

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that’s real-time and transparent.

jobs.title: Product Manager II - Financial Data
jobs.jd_full:
About AlphaSense:

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

Alpha-Sense is the leading market intelligence platform for key decision makers. We power some of the world’s most well-respected institutional investors, corporations, and consultancies through the largest and most comprehensive database of primary and market information. Our products and services enable clients to discover unmatched insights and answers to the most challenging questions they face to help them make better informed decisions.

Join the Financial Data Team at AlphaSense as a Product Manager specializing in Financial Data Generation & Presentation. Successful candidates will bring a strong analytical mindset, proficiency in financial reporting and structured financial data, and the ability to drive alignment across technical and business stakeholders.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own and evolve AlphaSense’s proprietary financial data taxonomy, inclusive of financial metrics reported across sectors, accounting standards, statements, and reporting patterns, ensuring both backwards compatibility and future proofing.
  • Understand financial data consumption patterns of capital markets participants and define how data generation rules apply across all sectors and data types, ensuring clients can intuitively discover, understand, and leverage the data AlphaSense has to offer.
  • Serve as the internal subject matter expert on financial data generation and presentation, and develop and maintain official internal and external documentation ensuring data standards are clearly articulated and accessible to all stakeholders.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, research, product, sales, and client-facing teams to align stakeholders on financial data generation and presentation rules and translate them into a dataset with depth, accuracy, and relevance to clients.
  • Proactively identify gaps and inconsistencies as new companies, metrics, and datasets are onboarded, driving efficient resolution in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
  • Define the use cases and requirements for new financial datasets that extend beyond the three core financial statements, driving their onboarding in a structured and scalable way.
  • Design and maintain financial data structures and taxonomy with AI and LLM compatibility as a core consideration, ensuring labels, definitions, and conventions support model training, inference, and broader AI-driven automation.
  • Lay the foundation for financial data expansion through building repeatable frameworks and processes, while positioning the dataset for scalable accuracy, relevance, and growth.

Who You Are:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a highly analytical field such as Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related discipline
  • 5+ years of experience working with data structures, taxonomy, or data governance, with at least 2 years in a product management or closely adjacent cross-functional role
  • A genuine interest in financial data and capital markets, with an understanding of how investors and financial professionals consume, interpret, and act on data
  • A proven analytical mindset, with the ability to translate complex, ambiguous data challenges into structured frameworks and scalable solutions
  • Hands-on experience leveraging AI and LLM tools as an internal practitioner and a genuine curiosity for how consumers of financial data are integrating AI into their workflows
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with a demonstrated ability to manage multiple workstreams and competing priorities independently
  • Proficiency in data management tools such as SQL and Python, with a willingness to expand your toolkit as the role evolves

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Alpha-Sense we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager - Security
jobs.jd_full:
About the Position

The Technical Project Manager I is an entry point to TEECOM’s external client-facing PM path, reporting to the Team Lead or to the most senior Technical Project Manager on the team. You are embedded in client engagements, coordinating technical implementation across real estate and IT environments. You are the client’s day-to-day point of contact for project execution, responsible for keeping delivery organized and communication clear.

This role may support a single client portfolio or broader multi-region work, depending on project needs. You are expected to work effectively across teams, clients, and time zones when needed while maintaining clear communication and follow-through.

You are expected to support technical implementation projects that span telecommunications infrastructure, structured cabling, audiovisual, security, acoustics, and wired and wireless networks. This includes helping coordinate multi-system integration efforts while maintaining organized delivery workflows and clear communication.

You partner with Subtask PMs, Project Supervisors, Group Leads, Team Leads, and project delivery teams to align day-to-day execution with project goals. You help keep delivery on track by monitoring dependencies, documenting decisions, and escalating risks early.

You serve as a dependable point of coordination for internal teams and client contacts. You reinforce disciplined execution and build confidence through responsiveness, follow-through, and clear documentation.

You lead by example by aligning your actions with your commitments and reinforcing accountability across every project touchpoint.

You also identify opportunities to improve workflows and strengthen process consistency through practical documentation updates.

Your impact is measured by execution reliability, documentation quality, communication clarity, your ability to support predictable project outcomes, and your contribution to client confidence, account continuity, and portfolio growth.

Project Execution, Mentorship, and Improving the TEECOM System

As a Technical Project Manager I, your impact is reflected in stronger project coordination, clearer visibility, more reliable documentation, and steadily increasing project management judgment.

  1. Project Coordination & Visibility
    • You improve day-to-day project reliability by keeping tasks, milestones, and dependencies visible and organized.
    • You help teams maintain alignment by communicating scope, schedule, and delivery dependencies clearly.
    • You reduce surprises by surfacing coordination issues early with supporting context.
    • You improve cross-team accountability by maintaining clear handoff ownership and decision follow-through.
    • You support predictable follow-through by maintaining clear workflows, trackers, and decision logs.
  2. Growth Through Mentorship and Exposure
    • You strengthen project management fundamentals through hands-on project experience.
    • You apply mentor feedback to improve prioritization, communication, and judgment.
    • You build financial and scope awareness through guided exposure to project controls.
  3. Improve the TEECOM System
    • You strengthen documentation quality by keeping project information current, structured, and accessible.
    • You support scope and contract clarity by maintaining accurate project records that reflect approved services.
    • You help reduce recurring friction by capturing and sharing lessons learned.
    • You strengthen PMO process consistency by contributing lessons learned, keeping your team current on PM documentation, and supporting quarterly process improvements.

What Success in this Position Looks Like

  • You support on-time, on-scope execution across assigned project tasks.
  • You maintain accurate project documentation, meeting notes, and action tracking.
  • You communicate project updates, blockers, and dependencies clearly and promptly.
  • You strengthen client confidence through responsive communication, dependable follow-through, and organized coordination.
  • You escalate risks early with clear context and proposed next steps.
  • You support implementation readiness by tracking dependencies and confirming handoff requirements.
  • You reinforce billing and forecasting discipline through accurate time and expense practices.
  • You strengthen team coordination through reliable follow-through and documentation discipline.
  • You apply lessons learned to improve repeatability and reduce delivery friction.
  • You contribute useful documentation and Pull Requests that improve team workflows.
  • You maintain Accounts Receivable (AR) over 90 days at less than 10% of total AR for assigned projects.
  • You keep project stale dates below 3% in VantagePoint.
  • You model TEECOM’s Core Values — Care, Trust, and Value — through accountability and professionalism.

Responsibilities and Expectations

Annual and Quarterly

  • Align project execution support with Project Delivery priorities and firmwide OKRs.
  • Support coordination with Client Relations Account Executives on account continuity and client portfolio visibility.
  • Participate in performance assessments and apply feedback to improve delivery reliability.
  • Strengthen project management fundamentals through training and mentorship.
  • Support client in-person event coordination that strengthens client appreciation and overall client experience.
  • Participate in quarterly Business Reviews for assigned projects by contributing status updates, documentation, and follow-through items.
  • Support quarterly project health reviews with updated documentation and status inputs.
  • Contribute to process improvements that increase workflow consistency.

Monthly and Biweekly

  • Track scope, schedule, and task dependencies across assigned projects.
  • Support PSA alignment and maintain scope documentation as project needs evolve.
  • Maintain project trackers, decision logs, and action registers with high accuracy.
  • Support status reporting by preparing clear updates on risks, dependencies, and progress.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams to keep implementation activities aligned.
  • Support procurement and delivery milestone visibility across assigned scopes.
  • Maintain structured project documentation that supports client portfolio visibility, transparency, and smooth team handoffs.

Weekly and Daily

  • Maintain clear visibility into project tasks, upcoming milestones, and delivery blockers.
  • Participate in project coordination meetings and publish clear notes with ownership and deadlines.
  • Coordinate effectively across teams and time zones to keep handoffs and decisions moving.
  • Support troubleshooting coordination by routing issues to the right teams and tracking resolution.
  • Communicate status changes early and escalate risks before they impact commitments.
  • Reinforce disciplined documentation, time, and expense practices.
  • Support client communication with clear, professional updates when directed.

As Needed

  • Support pursuit preparation, interview logistics, and proposal coordination.
  • Support scope updates and Professional Services Agreement (PSA) and Additional Services Agreement (ASA) documentation when scope shifts occur.
  • Assist with implementation readiness activities and handover tracking.
  • Contribute Pull Requests that improve documentation quality and delivery consistency.
  • Capture lessons learned to improve future project execution.
  • Maintain accurate client and project contact information in TEECOM’s CRM to support Client Relations continuity.
  • Document client feedback and coordinate follow-up actions with Subtask PMs, Project Supervisors, and Team Leads.
  • Support client feedback documentation and follow-up action tracking.

Supervisory / Mentorship / Training Responsibilities

  • Supervisory: None.
  • Mentorship: Receives structured mentorship from senior Technical Project Managers and Team Leads. Provides mentorship to the broader project team on documentation standards, coordination workflows, and implementation tracking practices.
  • Training: Participates in project management training that reinforces scope discipline, communication quality, and workflow consistency.

Experience and Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Construction Management, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience: 4+ years of experience in project coordination or project management within an AEC or professional services environment.
  • Preferred: Experience supporting technical implementation projects and cross-functional coordination workflows.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage defined project tasks with consistency and minimal rework.
  • Working understanding of scope, schedule, and delivery coordination fundamentals.
  • Strong organization and communication skills across multiple concurrent priorities.
  • Ability to maintain high-quality documentation and follow established workflows.
  • Strong proficiency in Asana, Microsoft 365 Suite, Google Workspace, Bluebeam, GitHub, VantagePoint, MS Project, Procore, and Navisworks.
  • Industry certifications:
    • CAPM — preferred
    • PMP — plus
    • CDT — plus

Physical Demands

These physical demands represent what is required to perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations will be provided as needed.

  • Prolonged desk work using a computer, keyboard, mouse, and telephone.
  • Regular reading, writing, and communication in virtual and in-person settings.
  • Occasional travel to client sites for meetings, surveys, or inspections.
  • Site walks may require standing or walking for extended periods, climbing stairs, and navigating construction or utility areas.
  • Field activities may involve bending, kneeling, or maneuvering in confined spaces.
  • May occasionally lift or move equipment weighing up to 25 pounds.

Work Environment

These work environment characteristics represent the conditions encountered while performing essential job functions. Reasonable accommodations will be provided as needed.

  • Approximately 50% of work is performed in a remote or office environment using standard office equipment.
  • Approximately 50% occurs at client sites, including construction environments and existing facilities.
  • Construction sites may include exposure to elevated noise levels, dust, uneven or unfinished walking surfaces, variable lighting conditions, and active construction operations.
  • Utility rooms and similar spaces may have restricted access or may not fully comply with ADA accessibility standards.
  • When access limitations exist, TEECOM will support coordinating reasonable accommodations with site-controlling contractor or alternative means to perform essential job functions.
  • All accidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions must be reported immediately to the site superintendent and internally to People Operations.

$115,000 - $150,000 a year

This compensation will vary depending on your role-related skills, experience, knowledge, and subject matter expertise. TEECOM is committed to making sure that we are the right fit for each applicant and that each applicant is the right fit for our team. As we get to know each other throughout the interview process, the compensation may vary within the stated range.

TEECOM offers a comprehensive benefits package to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision insurance for employees and their dependents, basic and voluntary life insurance, short-term and long-term disability coverage, a 401(k) plan with profit-sharing contributions, paid parental leave, lifestyle and legal benefits, pet benefits, and performance-based bonuses. Full-time exempt team members also enjoy flexible time off, and all employees receive nine scheduled paid holidays.

Your level will be evaluated and determined during the interview process.

We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor visas.

NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES: Please note that TEECOM does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of a signed Recruitment Fee Agreement, TEECOM will not consider or agree to payment of any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without a previously signed agreement, TEECOM explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of TEECOM.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Project Manager, Packaging Design & Artwork (Hybrid Role - New York)
jobs.jd_full:
OLAPLEX, a category-defining leader in prestige hair care, continuously seeks talented individuals to join in our mission to transform foundational hair health and deliver great hair days today, tomorrow, and for years to come.

As the original bond builder, we are dedicated to fostering a culture that celebrates the bonds within our teams. OLAPLEX elevates individuals from all backgrounds with the belief that together we can unlock the full potential of science to extend the health, life, and beauty of hair for all.

About the Role:

We are seeking a seasoned Project Manager, Packaging Design & Artwork. This role is designed for a high-level operator who thrives in fast-paced environments and can lead multiple packaging design projects, ensuring on-time delivery of final artwork.

As the operational lead for creative packaging initiatives, you will drive the creative workflow from creative concept through final artwork delivery, ensuring all cross-functional partners—from Marketing to Innovation to Packaging Engineering—are aligned and hitting specific creative milestones. You will play a critical role in providing support to two creative designers while trafficking concepts and artwork to keep projects moving forward efficiently.

Creative & Artwork Project Management

  •     Manage and monitor the end-to-end project timelines for all creative packaging concepts & final artwork initiatives
  •     Own creating the overall creative timeline, balancing project deadlines and resourcing; building an end-to-end project plan
  •     Manage and integrate multiple project timelines into a single cohesive resourcing plan
  •     Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment on creative deliverables and workstream dependencies
  •     Run weekly packaging design check-ins to track deliverables, drive alignment, surface risks, and manage competing deadlines
  •     Run daily design stand-ups with Packaging Design team, ensuring team knows daily priorities

Cross-Functional & Global Collaboration

  •     Act as the central operational partner between creative, brand marketing, product development, packaging engineering, and operations teams
  •     Partner with Campaign Ops lead to integrate packaging timelines into overall GTM timeline
  •     Lead collaborative relationships with key stakeholders at all levels, ensuring they are kept appropriately informed of project activities and kept accountable for respective steps

Process & Workflow Excellence

  •     Champion operational best practices using Asana and shared project tools
  •     Support Creative Packaging Design team in the day to day resourcing of packaging and misc projects
  •     Support planning consistency across the organization
  •     Maintain overarching calendars, workback trackers, and meeting cadence documents with the Creative and Packaging teams to support  calendars
  •     Drive accountability through clear task ownership and deadline transparency

Issue & Risk Management

  •     Identify timeline risks and blockers early; escalate issues with solutions in hand
  •     Proactively monitor cross-functional dependencies and potential impact on delivery
  •     Track shifting timelines and ensure impacts are clearly communicated
  •     Provide status reporting regarding project milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks and issues, communicating across Marketing leadership

Miscellaneous Creative Projects

  •     Project Manage ad hoc creative projects when needed

About You:

  • 5-6 years of experience specifically within Creative Operations or Creative Project Management, with a focus on packaging
  • High proficiency in Asana is required
  • A strong problem solver who can drive “out-of-the-box” thinking and course-correct projects when roadblocks arise
  • Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment with multiple shifting priorities
  • Exceptional partnership-building skills; ability to interface effectively with stakeholders at all levels and functions
  • Excellent attention to detail with thorough, effective follow-through on all project milestones

We’d love to have you apply, even if you don’t feel you meet every single requirement. What’s most important to us is finding authentic and accountable people who feel connected to our mission and values, not just candidates who check off all the boxes. We are looking for someone who will bring all their expertise, learn, and grow with us.

Our Total Rewards:

The annual base pay for this position is $100,000 - $115,000 with eligibility for an annual bonus. The actual base pay will vary based on factors such as qualifications, years of relevant experience, skill level, functional expertise, certificates or other professional licenses held and geographic location.

  • Competitive compensation
  • Work/Life Balance: Flexible paid time off, 11 paid holidays, and flexible work schedules
  • Wellness: Company Contribution to Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance for Employees and their Families, Company Paid Employee Life Insurance, Optional additional Life Insurance, and Short and Long-Term Disability Coverage Options
  • Parental Leave: Up to 18 weeks for birthing-parents and up to 10 weeks for non-birthing new parents
  • Financial Well-being: Roth and 401k plans: 100% match up to the first 4% and is immediately vested
  • Professional Development Reimbursement Program: Career development is as important to us as we know it is to you!
  • Our culture has an “attitude of gratitude” and a shared passion for our brand. Join our Bond Builder DEI committee to play a role celebrating DEI at OLAPLEX
  • Products: Twenty (20) free products per year, plus a friends and family discount

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion:

Our mission is to create a culture that celebrates our bonds by embracing, elevating, and empowering individuals from all backgrounds.

OLAPLEX is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, or religious creed, mental or physical disability, medical condition, genetic information, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, military or veteran status, citizenship, or other characteristics protected by state or federal law or local ordinance.
